name: writting-paper-skill-by-sheng
description: Draft and revise evidence-grounded English CS research papers in Jiawei Sheng's problem-mechanism-evidence style.

interface.shortDescription: Draft evidence-grounded CS research papers in Sheng's style.
interface.longDescription: A portable Agent Skill that drafts and revises English computer-science research papers using a problem-mechanism-evidence argument chain, while calibrating claims to supplied evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $writting-paper-skill-by-sheng to draft or revise this paper section.
Preserve technical meaning and calibrate every claim to the available evidence.
